name: AIAgentStack
description: Overlapping agent marks with status rings and an overflow count. Each mark carries its agent name and status as its accessible name.
intent: Several agents working at once, and what each of them is doing.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

props.name: agents
props.hint: Required. Declared in the component source.

props.name: maxVisible
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: size
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

requiredAttributes: A label per agent — generated from label and status
notes: Each mark is labelled "Name — status", so ring colour is never the only signal.
The group announces the total count, including agents hidden behind the overflow badge.
The overflow badge is visual only. Provide a full list elsewhere when the detail matters.

forbiddenUsage: Status conveyed only by ring colour
agentRules: Every agent needs a real label and a real status.
Keep maxVisible at three or four.
Provide a full list somewhere when there is overflow.
